subject: [PATCH v5 1/7] mm: support promotion-only NUMA hinting scans

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new NUMA hinting scan mode called 'promotion-only' that allows the kernel to focus on identifying when VMAs become active, rather than optimizing scanning activity based on heuristics like read-only VMAs or VMA activeness. The patch adds a new flag MM_CP_PROT_NUMA_PROMO_ONLY and modifies various functions in the mm module to use this flag to determine the type of walk to perform. This change is necessary for memory-tiering fixes and improves the interface by keeping it focused on scan intent, rather than plumbing VMA-derived state.
